from io import BytesIO
from datetime import date
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT, WD_CELL_VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.oxml.ns import qn

projects = [
    {"name": "东方集成", "progress": 0.72, "cost": 680000},
    {"name": "南方交付", "progress": 0.48, "cost": 420000},
    {"name": "北方设备", "progress": 0.91, "cost": 870000},
]
source_sha256 = "863b5a113c93210172b7fcd4b9e93e18a8a91dd5e178ea28c758e76994977fd6"

doc = Document()
sec = doc.sections[0]
sec.top_margin = Inches(0.7)
sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.7)
sec.left_margin = Inches(0.75)
sec.right_margin = Inches(0.75)

styles = doc.styles
styles["Normal"].font.name = "Microsoft YaHei"
styles["Normal"].font.size = Pt(10.5)
styles["Normal"]._element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "微软雅黑")
for s in ("Title", "Heading 1", "Heading 2"):
    styles[s].font.name = "Microsoft YaHei"
    styles[s]._element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "微软雅黑")

title = doc.add_heading("项目组合分析报告", 0)
title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
p = doc.add_paragraph("依据 source.xlsx「项目数据」工作表生成")
p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

doc.add_heading("一、执行摘要", level=1)
avg_progress = sum(x["progress"] for x in projects) / len(projects)
total_cost = sum(x["cost"] for x in projects)
max_progress = max(projects, key=lambda x: x["progress"])
min_progress = min(projects, key=lambda x: x["progress"])
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"本次共提取 3 个项目，平均进度为 {avg_progress:.1%}，成本合计为 ¥{total_cost:,.0f}。"
    f"北方设备进度最高（{max_progress['progress']:.0%}）；南方交付进度最低（{min_progress['progress']:.0%}），建议优先关注其交付节奏。"
)

doc.add_heading("二、提取的项目事实", level=1)
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=4)
table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
table.style = "Table Grid"
headers = ["项目", "进度", "成本（元）", "事实观察"]
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    cell = table.rows[0].cells[i]
    cell.text = h
    cell.vertical_alignment = WD_CELL_VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for run in cell.paragraphs[0].runs:
        run.bold = True
for x in projects:
    cells = table.add_row().cells
    cells[0].text = x["name"]
    cells[1].text = f"{x['progress']:.0%}"
    cells[2].text = f"{x['cost']:,.0f}"
    if x["progress"] >= 0.85:
        obs = "接近完成"
    elif x["progress"] >= 0.60:
        obs = "稳步推进"
    else:
        obs = "需重点关注"
    cells[3].text = obs

doc.add_heading("三、项目进度与成本图", level=1)
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.2, 4.4))
labels = ["Project 1", "Project 2", "Project 3"]
progress = [x["progress"] * 100 for x in projects]
cost_wan = [x["cost"] / 10000 for x in projects]
xpos = list(range(len(projects)))
bars = ax1.bar(xpos, progress, width=0.52, color=["#4C78A8", "#F58518", "#54A24B"], label="Progress (%)")
ax1.set_ylabel("Progress (%)")
ax1.set_ylim(0, 110)
ax1.set_xticks(xpos, [f"{labels[i]}\n{i+1}: {projects[i]['name']}" for i in range(3)])
ax1.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
for bar, v in zip(bars, progress):
    ax1.text(bar.get_x()+bar.get_width()/2, v+2, f"{v:.0f}%", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(xpos, cost_wan, color="#7A5195", marker="o", linewidth=2.2, label="Cost (CNY 10k)")
ax2.set_ylabel("Cost (CNY 10k)")
ax2.set_ylim(0, max(cost_wan)*1.25)
for i, v in enumerate(cost_wan):
    ax2.text(i, v+2.5, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", color="#7A5195", fontsize=9)
lines, labs = [], []
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    a, b = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
    lines += a; labs += b
ax1.legend(lines, labs, loc="upper left", frameon=False)
plt.title("Project Portfolio: Progress and Cost")
plt.tight_layout()
buf = BytesIO()
fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close(fig)
buf.seek(0)
doc.add_picture(buf, width=Inches(6.8))
cap = doc.add_paragraph("图 1：项目进度（柱）与成本（折线）对比。横轴编号依次对应东方集成、南方交付、北方设备。")
cap.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

doc.add_heading("四、分析结论", level=1)
for text in [
    "北方设备进度 91%，成本 870,000 元，处于接近完成阶段，也是当前成本最高的项目。",
    "东方集成进度 72%，成本 680,000 元，整体处于稳步推进阶段。",
    "南方交付进度 48%，成本 420,000 元，为三项中进度最低，建议核查里程碑、依赖与资源约束。",
    "成本与进度在这 3 个样本中同向变化，但样本量有限，不能据此推断成本投入与进度之间存在因果关系。"
]:
    doc.add_paragraph(text, style="List Bullet")

doc.add_heading("五、数据来源与可追溯性", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(f"来源文件：source.xlsx；工作表：项目数据；源文件 SHA-256：{source_sha256}。")
doc.add_paragraph("本报告中的项目名称、进度和成本均按提取结果原样写入；百分比仅作显示格式转换，成本汇总及平均进度由上述数据计算得到。")

out = "/workspace/analysis-report.docx"
doc.save(out)
print(f"created {out}")
